entries.before: Technology pays off only when the organization under it is ready: a plan people measure, a structure that can carry new work, procedures people follow, and data they trust. That is our work, and you can start with any part of it.

entries.before: A state answers for the federal-aid projects its local agencies deliver. We help the state set up the program: who does what at headquarters, in the districts, and at the local agency; a manual that covers a project from start to closeout; a certification process; and training built on the manual.
We help states and local agencies with the manuals, oversight, certification, and training that keep local federal-aid projects moving.
entries.after: We help state DOTs modernize their Local Public Agency (LPA) programs to improve project delivery, strengthen oversight, and ensure compliance with federal and state requirements. We assess and improve program processes, design organizational structures with clearly defined responsibilities, establish consistent oversight procedures, and develop comprehensive LPA manuals, guidance, and training for both DOT and local agency personnel. Our approach strengthens coordination and accountability, improves consistency in project development and delivery, and helps local agencies deliver federally funded projects on scope, on schedule, and within budget.

entries.before: We build change management into a reorganization, a new delivery process, or a technology project from the start, with the leaders who will carry the message.
We help staff understand and adopt a change, whether it's a reorganization, a new system, or a new way of delivering work: a change plan, change champions, communication, and training.
entries.after: We help transportation agencies successfully implement organizational, operational, and technological changes. Working with agency leadership, we develop change management strategies that engage employees, build organizational readiness, and accelerate adoption. Through communication, change champions, and targeted training, we help agencies transition to new structures, processes, and technologies—and sustain improvements over time.
